simple.meaning: כַּדְכֹּד (kadkôd) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a sparkling gem , probably the ruby.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.short: a sparkling gem , probably the ruby
definitions.full: H3539. kadkod כַּדְכֹּד noun [masculine] a precious stone, perhaps ruby (from sparkle ?; Aramaic || is כַּדְכְּדָנָא ); ׳כ Ezek 27:16 as article of commerce; כַּדְכֹֿד Isa 54:12 figurative in promise to Zion. כְּדֵי see דַּי . כדר (√ of following; compare Arabic VII. shoot or rush down (of hawk, star, etc.; also of an attacking force) so Thes Fl in De Job 15:24 Buhl Di and others; see also modern Arabic annoy, vex, reprimand , Spiro Vocab .; oftener be dark, gloomy, turbid , whence > כידור = seething tumult, of battle, compare Kö ii, 147, § 71, 1 ).
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 3537 in the sense of striking fire from a metal forged;
